sar.narrative: Customer C10434 holds card C10434-K1, which shows a history of 36 transactions from July through December 2016 across six billing regions with a median transaction amount of $90.00. On December 2, 2016 at 15:18:27, a $1,000.03 online transaction (product code R, billing region 469.0) was processed using this card from a device profile marked as new to the account (Windows 10, edge browser, 1366x768 resolution). This transaction is more than four times the cardholder's typical transaction amount. The activity occurred in the card-not-present online channel using a newly registered device, a pattern that matches eight structurally similar cases retrieved from the same billing region, all of which were confirmed fraud. The cardholder denies authorizing the transaction and reports still holding the card in their possession. Eight prior closed cases with the same pattern and region were confirmed fraud, ranging from $49.93 to $2,449.72 in exposure. The combination of an unusually large transaction amount, a card-not-present online channel, a device new to the account, the cardholder's denial of authorization, and the pattern match to confirmed fraud cases in the same region creates substantial suspicion of unauthorized use. The total suspicious amount is $1,000.03. The bank blocked the card and escalated the case for analyst review and suspicious activity reporting.
